Container.Name: universal-lookup-tailscale
Container.Overview:
Universal Lookup (Tailscale Edition) - Aggregated lookup service with built-in Tailscale support.
[b]Note:[/b] This version runs in Privileged mode with Tailscale persistence enabled.

Config.Name: Downdetector Client ID
Config.Description: Downdetector API v2 client id. Crowd-sourced outage data comes from the vendor's authenticated API instead of scraping its site. Without credentials these services report themselves unavailable and are skipped.

Config.Name: Downdetector Client Secret
Config.Description: Downdetector API v2 client secret.

Config.Name: Downdetector Base URL
Config.Description: Downdetector API base URL. The .head variant is the vendor's bleeding-edge deployment.

Config.Name: Downdetector Services
Config.Description: Services to read from the Downdetector API, as slug=Label=icon=Category (comma-separated). Same grammar as the allestörungen list, so a list moves across unchanged.

Config.Name: Downdetector Country
Config.Description: Which Downdetector site the slugs belong to; company ids are per-site.

Config.Name: Downdetector Token TTL
Config.Description: Seconds to reuse a Bearer token. Tokens last an hour; the vendor suggests refreshing five minutes early.

Config.Name: Downdetector Company TTL
Config.Description: Seconds to cache a slug's company id. Ids do not change.

Config.Name: Downdetector TTL
Config.Description: Seconds to cache a service reading. The upstream only re-times every ~15 min.

Config.Name: Downdetector Min Reports
Config.Description: Reports in the last 15 minutes at or above which a service counts as down. Used only when the API returns no verdict of its own.

Config.Name: Allestörungen Enabled
Config.Description: Use the old allestörungen scrape instead of the Downdetector API. Off by default: Cloudflare serves every Downdetector-family domain an active JS challenge, so neither the plain fetch nor the headless escalation can return data, and a cold status fan-out starved every other provider. Set to true only if the site becomes reachable again.

Config.Name: Allestörungen Domain
Config.Description: Downdetector locale domain (allestörungen.de, downdetector.com, ...)

Config.Name: Allestörungen Escalate On Warning
Config.Description: Let a 'warning' reading escalate an existing provider, not just 'danger'

Config.Name: Allestörungen Factor
Config.Description: Count reports as elevated only above baseline * this factor

Config.Name: Allestörungen Locale
Config.Description: Site locale for the crowd-sourced outage board

Config.Name: Allestörungen Map Override
Config.Description: Override the service->slug enrichment map; empty slug disables one

Config.Name: Allestörungen Min Gap (ms)
Config.Description: Minimum gap between requests; the site challenges bursts

Config.Name: Allestörungen Min Reports
Config.Description: Ignore an outage flag below this many reports

Config.Name: Allestörungen Services
Config.Description: Extra services to cover, as slug[=Label[=icon]], comma-separated

Config.Name: Allestörungen TTL (s)
Config.Description: How long to cache the crowd-sourced board

Config.Name: Allestörungen Use Browser
Config.Description: Escalate to headless Chromium when plain HTTP is challenged. Off: the challenge is a JS interstitial a real headful browser could not clear, so the escalation only ever burned CPU.

Config.Name: Allestörungen User Agent
Config.Description: User-Agent for the crowd-sourced board (leave empty for the default)

Config.Name: Status Maintenance Windows
Config.Description: service:day:startHour-endHour[:Name], comma-separated, day 0=Sunday, UTC

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface. Serves the same Fastify server as the API port - the built SPA is served by the backend, there is no separate web process.

Config.Description: Port for the Fastify API backend

Config.Description: Persistent state for Tailscale

Config.Name: FritzBox Skip Phonebooks
Config.Description: Phonebooks to leave undownloaded, by name (comma-separated, case-insensitive substring). A FRITZ!Box publishes its call-barring and spam-score lists as phonebooks next to real contacts; on one box the barring list alone was 315 KB of a 360 KB total and holds nothing worth resolving a caller against. Matched before the book is fetched. Empty fetches all.

Config.Name: FritzBox Phonebook Revalidate (s)
Config.Description: Seconds a downloaded phonebook is used without contacting the box. Short because checking is nearly free: the box answers an unchanged book with about 220 bytes instead of the whole thing, so a new contact appears within a minute.

Config.Name: FritzBox Phonebook TTL (s)
Config.Description: Seconds after which a phonebook is downloaded in full regardless - a safety net for a box whose reported timestamp fails to move when its contents do.

Config.Name: Google API Key
Config.Description: Google Maps & Search API key (optional)

Config.Name: Google Search CX
Config.Description: Google Custom Search Engine ID (optional)

Config.Name: Host
Config.Description: Binding address. Not HOST - the Unraid Tailscale hook overwrites that name with the tailnet hostname.

Config.Name: ip-api.com Key
Config.Description: API key for ip-api.com (optional, enables HTTPS + unlimited)

Config.Name: ip-api.io Key
Config.Description: API key for ip-api.io advanced features

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging level (error, warn, info, debug)

Config.Name: Location Warnings Enabled
Config.Description: Enable the DWD (severe weather) and NINA (civil protection, incl. official utility/water outages) warning providers. Germany only.

Config.Name: Location Weather Enabled
Config.Description: Enable current conditions from Open-Meteo. Worldwide, needs no API key.

Config.Name: Location Warnings German
Config.Description: Prefer the German original where a warning carries both languages

Config.Name: Location NINA Detail Limit
Config.Description: How many NINA warnings to fetch full CAP detail for; each is one extra request

Config.Name: Location Geocode TTL
Config.Description: Seconds to cache a geocode, shared by every location provider (keeps us inside Nominatim 1 req/s)

Config.Name: MaxMind License Key
Config.Description: MaxMind GeoLite2 license key

Config.Name: ParcelsApp API Key
Config.Description: ParcelsApp tracking API key

Config.Name: PhoneBlock API Key
Config.Description: PhoneBlock API key (optional; the number lookup is public, a key only adds your personal block/allow list)

Config.Name: PhoneBlock Password
Config.Description: PhoneBlock account password (deprecated upstream; only used when no API key is set)

Config.Name: PhoneBlock User
Config.Description: PhoneBlock account user (deprecated upstream; only used when no API key is set)

Config.Name: Phone Country Prefix
Config.Description: Country prefix for phone numbers

Config.Name: Phone Local Prefix
Config.Description: Local prefix for phone numbers

Config.Name: Original Entrypoint
Config.Description: Image ENTRYPOINT for the Tailscale hook to hand off to. This image has none; leave empty.

Config.Name: Original Command
Config.Description: Image CMD for the Tailscale hook to exec after connecting. Required whenever Tailscale is enabled, or the container exits as soon as the tunnel is up.

Config.Name: Providers Blacklist
Config.Description: Comma-separated providers or whole lookup types to disable (e.g. web,steam-xml). Empty = everything runs.

Config.Name: Puppeteer Args
Config.Description: Extra Chromium launch arguments

Config.Name: Puppeteer Executable Path
Config.Description: Path to Chromium (Docker/Unraid: /usr/bin/chromium)

Config.Name: Puppeteer Skip Download
Config.Description: Skip downloading Chromium (use system binary in Docker)

Config.Name: Puppeteer Idle Timeout (ms)
Config.Description: How long the shared headless browser is kept alive after its last page closes, so consecutive scrapes reuse one browser instead of launching a new one each time.

Config.Name: Puppeteer Timeout (ms)
Config.Description: Max wait time for headless browser

Config.Name: Rate Limit Max
Config.Description: Max requests per time window

Config.Name: Rate Limit Window
Config.Description: Rate limit time window

Config.Name: Server Timeout (ms)
Config.Description: Max time for background processing to update cache

Config.Name: DNS Timeout (ms)
Config.Description: Per-record ceiling for the DNS provider. Node's resolver has no timeout of its own, so without this a silent nameserver holds a lookup open indefinitely.

Config.Name: Puppeteer Wait Until
Config.Description: When a scraped page counts as loaded. networkidle2 waits for the network to go quiet, which never happens on a page with polling or analytics, so the navigation burns its whole budget and a full browser with it. domcontentloaded returns as soon as the markup is parsed, which is all a scraper needs.

Config.Name: Log Process Spawns
Config.Description: Log every external process the service starts - each browser, each browser page it opens, ping and traceroute - with its lifetime and why it ended (idle-timeout / shutdown / died). This is how a browser outliving the request that launched it becomes visible. Set false to silence.

Config.Name: Allestoerungen Breaker Threshold
Config.Description: allestoerungen.net answers scrapers with a Cloudflare challenge. Rather than pay a full navigation timeout per German ISP status provider per request, stop calling it after this many consecutive failures.

Config.Name: Allestoerungen Breaker Cooldown (s)
Config.Description: Seconds to wait before trying allestoerungen.net again once the breaker has opened.

Config.Name: SearXNG URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your own SearXNG instance, e.g. https://search.example.com. This container talks to the host over the Docker bridge gateway, so a SearXNG running on the Unraid host itself is reached as http://172.17.0.1:28080 - not localhost, which inside the container is the container. Leave empty to disable the provider. The instance needs `json` in `search.formats` in its settings.yml for the JSON API; without it the provider reports that and falls back to parsing the HTML.

Config.Name: SearXNG Timeout (ms)
Config.Description: How long to wait for the SearXNG instance before giving up.
